passage: The water circulation pump P-12 vibrated during startup. The team replaced its worn coupling and vibration returned to the usual range.
Pressure across the inlet filter rose to 38 kPa. The operator isolated the loop and replaced the blocked filter cartridge.
Thermocouple T-4 read 15 degrees above the reference probe. The team quarantined its measurements pending sensor calibration.
The cooling valve V-3 stuck closed. Cooling flow fell to 2 litres per minute. The operator stopped the furnace and tagged the valve for repair.
The desk node battery voltage dropped to 3.2 V under load. Charging the battery restored the wireless connection.
Dust on the camera lens caused blurry inspection images. Cleaning the lens restored image sharpness without changing exposure.
Before opening a cooling line, isolate its energy source, release pressure and verify zero energy according to the lab procedure.
Every shift handoff records the equipment identifier, observed issue, action taken and unresolved follow-up. Do not invent missing measurements.
